_instructions.purpose: Edit this file to update upcoming STEM PoC meetings. The website automatically displays the next scheduled meeting on profile.html and index.html — no HTML editing required.
_instructions.important: Do not edit profile.html or index.html just to change meeting information. Add or edit an entry in the meetings array below instead.

fields.id: Required. A short unique string, e.g. "2026-03-poc-meeting".
fields.title: Optional. Defaults to "STEM PoC Meeting" if left blank.
fields.date: Required. YYYY-MM-DD calendar date — this is what the site sorts on.
fields.location: Optional. e.g. "Virtual — Teams" or a physical address.
fields.status: One of: scheduled, tentative, completed, cancelled. Cancelled meetings are never shown as next. Completed meetings are treated as historical.
fields.summary: Optional. One or two sentences describing the meeting.
fields.priorities: Optional array of short strings — what the meeting will focus on.
fields.preparation: Optional array of short strings — what to do before the meeting.
fields.agendaItems: Optional array. Either plain strings, or objects like {"time":"10:00 AM","title":"...","description":"..."}.
fields.links: Optional. meeting / agenda / resources URLs — a button only appears for links that are filled in.
